$description.$value: Layout and size tokens for the Icon atom — static, component, and inline-text size variants.

xs.$description: 16px fixed. Does not react to ui_scale mode.

sm.$description: 20px fixed. Does not react to ui_scale mode.

md.$description: Default. 24px fixed. Does not react to any size mode.

lg.$description: 32px fixed. Does not react to ui_scale mode.

xs.$description: Smallest icon size. Reacts to ui_scale mode.

sm.$description: Small icon size. Reacts to ui_scale mode.

md.$description: Default icon size. Reacts to ui_scale mode.

lg.$description: Large icon size. Reacts to ui_scale mode.

body.$description: Inline icon size for body text only. Reacts to typography_context mode.

offset.$description: Upward optical baseline offset for inline icons with adjacent capital letters. Fixed at 2px (= 0.125em at 16px base). Figma does not support em units — devs should implement as 0.125em in CSS so the offset scales proportionally with the adjacent text size. Does not react to any mode.
